name: Rolling

beschreibung.text: Rolling 16th-note bass: detuned saws an octave over a sine sub, plucked by a fast filter envelope, ends before the next 16th.

notiz: Source rule: recipe card `bass.rolling`, Snoman [B3] p. 443. Measured by `tests/rezepte.rs`, not yet heard. Manifest use words outside the vocabulary: groove (as drop).
